messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v3.9.4 -> 7% traffic to eu-west-2 + us-east-1. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Health checks: 15m error-rate + p95 latency. Release notes: <internal/release/3.9.4>

andrew: Noted. Small client-side change to retry jitter in this release. Watch for retry amplification and increased backend 5xx.

jen: Early telemetry: eu-west-2 showing a rise in 5xx from gateway at ~02:06 (0.01% -> 0.4%). Samples point to transient connection resets when retries spike.

sam: I see correlating spike in request retries from mobile SDK variants 2.x. Could be the jitter window reduction.

andrew: We intentionally tightened jitter to reduce mean latency, but this may concentrate retries. Suggest PAUSE further percent increase and pin eu-west-2 to v3.9.3 while we decide whether to widen jitter or toggle a runtime flag.

oncall-bot: @jen, @sam — oncall is cory. Pager notified.

cory: Oncall here. Quick triage: are resets server side or network? If server-side, a rollback might be safest; if client-only, pinning region is fine.

jen: Traces show backend 502s from session-proxy due to short-lived connection exhaustion. Repro script in gist: `tools/sim_retries.py --clients 300 --jitter 8ms` induces the same pattern.

andrew: Given repro, plan: 1) pause ramp; 2) pin eu-west-2 to v3.9.3; 3) push temporary runtime knob to widen jitter to 20ms across canary pool OR revert retry change. Runtime knob is faster.

sam: Commands to run if approved:
```
# pause rollout
deployctl rollout pause --version=3.9.4 --strategy=percent
# pin region
deployctl pin --version=3.9.3 --routes=eu-west-2 --reason="retry amplification -> 5xx spike"
# apply runtime knob (infra)
infractl set runtime --key=client.retry.jitter_ms --value=20 --scope=canary
```

jen: Approve. Execute pause & pin now; then apply runtime knob.

cory: Running pause + pin. Will post deployctl exec id.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by cory (exec-20260323-500). No further percent increases will be applied.

deploy-bot: Pins applied: eu-west-2 -> v3.9.3.

andrew: Runtime knob applied to canary pool: client.retry.jitter_ms=20ms. Monitoring for 10m.

sam: After knob, early metrics: gateway 5xx in eu-west-2 fell from 0.4% -> 0.06% in 4m. Retry rate normalized.

jen: Creating incident INC-20260323-255 assigned to andrew for follow-up hotfix (either widen jitter permanently or add client compatibility note). Hotfix plan: add runtime-configurable jitter in the client SDK and server-side safe defaults.

cory: Decision summary: STOP further rollout. Pin eu-west-2 to stable. Apply runtime knob as mitigation. Hotfix + SDK update before any GO. If knob stabilizes for 15m, consider a cautious 2% reintroduce with knob in place.

andrew: I'll open PRs and schedule a quick canary with the knob for 15m before reconvening.

sam: Notifying mobile SDK owners and product about the pause and mitigation.

deploy-bot: Thread paused. Reopen or @cory for GO when ready.
